Characteristics [Category]: bulk ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility profiling of a human cervical adenocarcinoma cell line
Material Type: Bulk Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing (bulk ATAC-seq) on HeLa cells, an immortal epithelial cervical adenocarcinoma model from a 31-year-old female patient, associated with HPV18 and widely used for cancer, virology, and cell-cycle regulation studies.
Parameter [dna_extraction]: Bulk ATAC-seq nuclei preparation from adherent tumor cells: nuclei from the cell population are isolated and exposed to Tn5 transposase so open chromatin regions are simultaneously fragmented and adapter-tagged.
